summary: NDR feed s088_single shows 2.3% TCP packet loss (42/1854 packets) exceeding 1% threshold; all other visibility checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Capture path is dropping packets before the NDR - most likely SPAN/mirror port oversubscription or packet broker buffer exhaustion under burst load, evidenced by gaps in TCP sequence numbers (2.27% missing data). SPAN ports are known to drop when ingress exceeds egress capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reliably reassemble TCP sessions or perform full payload analysis; 2.3% loss breaks flow records and signature matching, reducing detection coverage for lateral movement and exfiltration and increasing false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Replace lossy SPAN/mirror with passive TAP (or TAP aggregation) to provide lossless, line-rate copy to the packet broker and eliminate buffer drops; if TAP already in use, add packet broker filtering/load-balancing or increase egress capacity.
